visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two sisters are seated at a white table in a well-lit, contemporary living room. The older sister on the left wears a white hoodie and gently cradles a fluffy white Pomeranian dog. The younger sister on the right is dressed in a black hoodie, her hands resting calmly on the table. The background features neutral-toned furniture, a gray sofa, and soft, warm lighting setup from overhead lamps and ambient kitchen lights. (2) A man's arm enters the frame, placing a large cardboard box on the table. The girls' eyes widen and they open their mouths in expressions of extreme surprise and joy. The mother, in a black shirt, appears behind them. They all start reaching into the box with fast, energetic hand movements, pulling out various yogurt bottles with colorful labels and large white plastic yogurt containers. (3) Close-up shots highlight the specific labels of the Snow Factory yogurt drinks, showing flavors like blueberry and passion fruit. The girls are shown holding the bottles close to their faces, smiling brightly at the camera with squinted eyes and joyful facial expressions. The mother is seen taking a drink from a pink bottle, her expression one of satisfaction and enjoyment as she interacts with her daughters. (4) They open a white foam box, revealing small tubs of yogurt ice cream. The younger girl is shown using a spoon to eat the ice cream, her facial expressions conveying pure delight. All three characters then pose together, giving thumbs-up gestures and pointing towards the products. The scene is dynamic, with multiple quick cuts showing different product angles and energetic family interactions.

It utilizes a 'surprise box' opening hook to capture interest, followed by a high-energy family interaction that demonstrates the products' appeal to different age groups. The narrative concludes with a direct call to action for a limited-time group purchase.
